jobs.title: Software Engineer (Product)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Numeral:

  • Numeral is transforming how taxes get done. Digital businesses are currently bogged down by a painful web of regulations across 47 states and 50+ countries. We’re eliminating this burden so teams can focus on their core mission.

  • We’re the largest and fastest growing AI-native tax solution. Started in 2023, Numeral has raised over $57M from Benchmark, Mayfield, Y-Combinator, and many others. We now serve over 2,500 paying customers and have more than tripled our revenue every year in our history.

  • We’re primarily hiring in our SF and NY offices, but do hire remotely in some cases

About the role:

We’re looking for a foundational Full-Stack Engineer who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys building complex distributed systems, and wants to define foundational architecture in a fast-growing early-stage startup. You’ll lead the design and implementation of APIs, services, and infrastructure that underpin our platform. You’ll also help drive engineering strategy, product execution, and cultural foundations alongside leadership.

What you’ll do

  • Design and build scalable, secure backend services and APIs from scratch.

  • Make architectural decisions that optimize for speed, data integrity, and long-term maintainability.

  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and data teams to develop performant systems that power key customer workflows.

  • Own infrastructure, observability, and performance for the services you build.

  • Help shape engineering best practices, code quality, and our overall backend culture.

What you'll bring:

  • 7+ years of experience building backend systems in high-growth environments.

  • Fluency with backend technologies like Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, and cloud services (AWS preferred).

  • Experience designing robust APIs and distributed systems at scale.

  • Strong product sensibility—able to balance performance, flexibility, and speed.

  • Startup mindset: Not scared of ambiguity and hungry for rapid growth

  • Intensity & Ownership: This is not a 9-5 — we’re scaling rapidly and have a massive opportunity ahead of us.

  • Customer Obsession: You deeply care about the user experience and solving their problems

Even better:

  • Experience in payments, tax, accounting, or regulatory tech.

  • Infrastructure or platform engineering background (e.g., CI/CD, observability).

  • Experience scaling monolith-to-service architectures or event-driven systems.

  • Familiarity with GraphQL, Kafka, Terraform, or container orchestration tools.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity - you'll share directly in the company's success

  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Wellness perks like Headspace and the Peloton One App

  • 401(k) to help you build long-term financial security

  • Lunch and snacks when you're in the office

  • Regular team offsites and company events as we grow

  • A culture built on ownership - your work matters and people will see it!

jobs.title: Founding Solutions Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:

  • Numeral is transforming how taxes get done. Digital businesses are currently bogged down by a painful web of regulations across 47 states and 50+ countries. We’re eliminating this burden so teams can focus on their core mission.

  • We’re the largest and fastest growing AI-native tax solution. Started in 2023, Numeral has raised over $57M from Benchmark, Mayfield, Y-Combinator, and many others. We now serve over 2,500 paying customers and have more than tripled our revenue every year in our history.

  • We’re primarily hiring in our SF and NY offices, but do hire remotely in some cases

About the role:

  • We’re hiring a Founding Deployment Engineer who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, customer engagement, and product design. You’ll own the full technical sales lifecycle — from designing pre-sales demos to advising on architecture, and all the way through post-sales implementation. This role is ideal for an engineer who loves being customer-facing and wants to build product, not just pitch it. You’ll work cross-functionally with Sales, Engineering, and Product to not only drive customer success, but also directly shape the features we build based on real customer needs. You’ll be our first hire in this function — which means you’ll have significant autonomy, impact, and ownership.

What you’ll do:

  • Partner with Sales to lead technical discovery, run product demos, and scope integrations for prospective customers.

  • Own the technical onboarding and implementation process — from solution design to production launch.

  • Build and maintain demo environments, proof-of-concepts, and integration documentation to streamline customer onboarding.

  • Work directly with Engineering and Product to translate customer requirements into new features and improvements.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers on architecture, APIs, and best practices.

  • Create internal tools and automations that improve solution delivery.

  • Be the voice of the customer — bring learnings back to the product and engineering team to inform roadmap decisions.

What you’ll bring:

  • 8+ years of experience as a Deployment Engineer, Software Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Sales Engineer at a SaaS company.

  • Strong coding skills (ideally in Python, JavaScript, or similar) and experience working with APIs.

  • Proven experience working directly with customers in a technical capacity.

  • Excellent communication skills — ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to operate in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

  • Startup mindset: Not scared of ambiguity and hungry for rapid growth

  • Intensity & Ownership: This is not a 9-5 — we’re scaling rapidly and have a massive opportunity ahead of us.

  • Customer Obsession: You deeply care about the user experience and solving their problems

Even better:

  • Experience building or supporting integrations in the fintech or tax compliance space.

  • Familiarity with sales tax systems, accounting software, or ERP platforms.

  • Prior experience in a startup or early-stage environment.

  • Previous work in both pre-sales and post-sales engineering.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity - you’ll share directly in the company’s success

  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Wellness perks like Headspace and the Peloton One App

  • 401(k) to help you build long-term financial security

  • Lunch and snacks when you’re in the office

  • Regular team offsites and company events as we grow

  • A culture built on ownership - your work matters and people will see it!

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager (International)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Numeral:

  • Numeral is transforming how taxes get done. Digital businesses are currently bogged down by a painful web of regulations across 47 states and 50+ countries. We’re eliminating this burden so teams can focus on their core mission.

  • We’re the largest and fastest growing AI-native tax solution. Started in 2023, Numeral has raised over $57M from Benchmark, Mayfield, Y-Combinator, and many others. We now serve over 2,500 paying customers and have more than tripled our revenue every year in our history.

  • We’re primarily hiring in our SF and NY offices, but do hire remotely in some cases

About the role:

As Business Operations Manager, International Operations, you’ll play a foundational role in launching and scaling Numeral’s product in global markets. From owning the development and execution of tax workflows across VAT, GST, and indirect tax systems including research and registration to process design and automation.

You’ll partner with Product, Engineering, and GTM teams to launch new countries, support compliance at scale, and continuously improve systems that blend human operations with AI-powered workflows.

This is a high impact role with the opportunity to directly shape our international expansion strategy and build repeatable playbooks that will power the next stage of Numeral’s growth.

What you’ll do:

  • Launch our product in new countries: Own end-to-end delivery of international launches—from operational research and tooling to stakeholder coordination and SOP development.

  • Design scalable tax workflows: Build repeatable, automation-friendly processes for VAT/GST compliance using a combination of RPA tools, SQL, and AI agents.

  • Own rollouts from 0–1: Pilot new operational systems, document workflows, train the team, and scale across regions.

  • Improve efficiency & automation: Identify bottlenecks, reduce manual execution time, and implement automation and tooling to increase leverage.

  • Triage edge cases and escalations: Support customer and internal teams by solving complex international operations issues, then build systems to prevent them in the future.

  • Document and scale knowledge: Create internal SOPs and operational guides to ensure the team can scale with quality and consistency.

  • Partner across teams: Collaborate with Product, Sales, and Customer Experience to enable seamless rollouts and drive go-to-market success in each region.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years in operations at a fintech, SaaS, or compliance-focused startup

  • 2+ years of remote work in globally distributed teams

  • Proven experience building structured processes in ambiguous, early-stage environments

  • Familiarity with process automation tools (Google Sheets, AppScript, RPA frameworks)

  • Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills

  • Startup mindset: Not scared of ambiguity and hungry for rapid growth

  • Intensity & Ownership: This is not a 9-5 — we’re scaling rapidly and have a massive opportunity ahead of us.

  • Customer Obsession: You deeply care about the user experience and solving their problems

Even better:

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a tax-adjacent field

  • Prior experience in indirect tax (VAT/GST) product or compliance operations

  • SQL proficiency and comfort working with relational databases

  • Experience implementing AI tools or automation agents into operational workflows

  • Exposure to Salesforce and state/international tax portals

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity - you’ll share directly in the company’s success

  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Wellness perks like Headspace and the Peloton One App

  • 401(k) to help you build long-term financial security

  • Lunch and snacks when you’re in the office

  • Regular team offsites and company events as we grow

  • A culture built on ownership - your work matters and people will see it!

Numeral is building the automation backbone for internet commerce — starting with the painful world of sales tax compliance. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Tax and Filings
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Numeral:

  • Numeral is transforming how taxes get done. Digital businesses are currently bogged down by a painful web of regulations across 47 states and 50+ countries. We’re eliminating this burden so teams can focus on their core mission.

  • We’re the largest and fastest growing AI-native tax solution. Started in 2023, Numeral has raised over $57M from Benchmark, Mayfield, Y-Combinator, and many others. We now serve over 2,500 paying customers and have more than tripled our revenue every year in our history.

  • We’re primarily hiring in our SF and NY offices, but do hire remotely in some cases

About the role:

As the Senior Manager, Tax and Filings, you’ll lead Numeral’s filings operations, overseeing a distributed team responsible for tax filings. You’ll work closely with leadership, the broader Ops team, product, and engineering to ensure accuracy, process discipline, and operational excellence across a team of approx. 50 (and growing!), including offshore contractors.

This role is a blend of operational leader, process architect, and people manager.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead and manage the filings team: Provide performance management, mentorship, and support to drive high-quality work and accountability.

  • Scale processes: Maximize automation to reduce repetitive tasks so teams can focus on highest leverage opportunities.

  • Drive operational excellence: Design, implement, and refine workflows and processes across filings, customer support, and client teams.

  • Ensure compliance and accuracy: Troubleshoot discrepancies in accounting or filings, and lead research projects on new regulatory rules.

  • Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with product and engineering to communicate business issues, escalate risks, and contribute to operational solutions.

What you’ll bring:

  • 7+ years of demonstrated domain expertise in U.S. tax filings; international experience a plus.

  • Proven experience managing distributed teams with strong performance management and process implementation skills.

  • Experience building scalable processes in a startup, high-growth environment or consulting firm.

  • Experience in e-commerce, SaaS or Fintech is highly preferred.

  • Familiarity with regulatory reporting systems, tools, or platforms used in finance and filings.

  • Strong analytical and Excel/data skills.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Critical thinker with a proactive problem-solving mindset.

  • Proven ability to work cross functionally with product and engineering.

  • Startup mindset: Not scared of ambiguity and hungry for rapid growth

  • Intensity & Ownership: This is not a 9-5 — we’re scaling rapidly and have a massive opportunity ahead of us.

  • Customer Obsession: You deeply care about the user experience and solving their problems

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity - you’ll share directly in the company’s success

  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Wellness perks like Headspace and the Peloton One App

  • 401(k) to help you build long-term financial security

  • Lunch and snacks when you’re in the office

  • Regular team offsites and company events as we grow

  • A culture built on ownership - your work matters and people will see it!

  • We’re primarily hiring in our SF and NY offices, but do hire remotely in some cases

The Opportunity

We are at a critical inflection point. Numeral is scaling from 80 to 300 employees over the next few years. To do that without breaking our culture or lowering our bar, we need more than just a recruiter who fills seats—we need an architect.

As our Founding Recruiter, you won’t just be closing candidates; you will build the operating system for how Numeral hires. You will partner directly with our Founders and C-suite to define what "great" looks like, implement the infrastructure (Ashby, scorecards, training) to get us there, and personally headhunt the leadership and engineering talent that will define our future.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build the "Talent Machine": Design and implement structured interview loops, scorecarding, and interviewer training to ensure every hire raises the average.

  • Hunt, Don’t Just Gather: Lead outbound sourcing strategies to extract top-tier talent from other high-growth tech companies.

  • Own the Stack: You are the admin and architect of our hiring funnel (Ashby, sourcing tools, etc).

  • Protect the Experience: Ensure that every candidate leaves the process respecting Numeral.

What you’ll bring:

  • 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience across engineering and business roles

  • Creative sourcing skills—world class sourcing is an art

  • High agency—you don’t wait for permission to fix broken processes

 - We’re the largest and fastest growing AI-native tax solution. Started in 2023, Numeral has raised over $57M from Benchmark, Mayfield, Y-Combinator, and many others. We now serve over 2,500 paying customers and have more than tripled our revenue every year in our history.

 - We’re primarily hiring in our SF and NY offices, but do hire remotely in some cases


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Drive execution for the core product: Partner with the CBO and Co-Founders to translate strategy into clear plans, priorities, and execution milestones.

 - Design scalable workflows: Build repeatable, automation-friendly processes for teams using a combination of RPA tools, SQL, and AI agents.

 - Improve operating rigor and efficiency: Identify friction points in product development, launch, and post-launch workflows. Design and implement lightweight processes, dashboards, and operating rhythms to improve execution speed and clarity.

 - Support data-informed decisions: Pull together insights from product, operational, and customer data to inform leadership decisions. Help define and track metrics that reflect product health and operational leverage.

 - Own rollouts from 0–1: Pilot new operational systems, document workflows, train the team, and scale across regions.

 - Crossfunctional collaboration: Help drive planning, prioritization, and follow-through across Product, Engineering, and Operations.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

 - 5+ years of experience in Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, Program Management, or Product Operations roles at a high-growth company.

 - Familiarity with process automation tools (Google Sheets, AppScript, RPA frameworks)

 - Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills.

 - Generalist skill set with the ability to move between strategy, execution, and problem-solving.

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

 - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

 - Comfort working cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams.

 - Startup mindset: Not scared of ambiguity and hungry for rapid growth

 - Intensity & Ownership: This is not a 9-5 — we’re scaling rapidly and have a massive opportunity ahead of us.

 - Customer Obsession: You deeply care about the user experience and solving their problems


EVEN BETTER:

 - Experience working closely with senior leadership (COO, CPO, or founders).

 - Exposure to fintech, SaaS, payments, or regulated industries.

 - Strong analytical skills (Excel / Sheets; SQL familiarity a plus).

 - Experience building operating cadences (OKRs, planning cycles, execution reviews).

 - Prior experience at an early-stage or rapidly scaling company.


WHAT WE OFFER:

 - Competitive salary and equity - you’ll share directly in the company’s success

 - Full medical, dental, and vision coverage

 - Wellness perks like Headspace and the Peloton One App

 - 401(k) to help you build long-term financial security

 - Lunch and snacks when you’re in the office

 - Regular team offsites and company events as we grow

 - A culture built on ownership - your work matters and people will see it!

jobs.title: International Tax Operations Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Numeral:

  • Numeral is transforming how taxes get done. Digital businesses are currently bogged down by a painful web of regulations across 47 states and 50+ countries. We’re eliminating this burden so teams can focus on their core mission.

  • We’re the largest and fastest growing AI-native tax solution. Started in 2023, Numeral has raised over $57M from Benchmark, Mayfield, Y-Combinator, and many others. We now serve over 2,500 paying customers and have more than tripled our revenue every year in our history.

  • We’re primarily hiring in our SF and NY offices, but do hire remotely in some cases

About the role:

We are hiring an International Tax Operations Manager to help define, scale, and operationalize Numeral’s global tax filing capabilities. This role is not responsible for preparing or submitting tax returns. Instead, you will:

  • Identify and document tax filing requirements

  • Translate tax rules into system and workflow requirements

  • Triage complex or non-standard filing issues

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Filings, and Sales to build scalable solutions

This is a tax + systems + problem-solving role, ideal for someone who enjoys building structure and clarity in complex regulatory environments.

What You’ll Do

Tax Requirements & Coverage

  • Identify and document registration, transfer and filing requirements across U.S. and international jurisdictions for indirect tax.

  • Define deadlines, formats, data dependencies, validations, and exceptions needed to support compliant filings.

  • Maintain and evolve internal requirements documentation as regulations change.

Issue Triage & Escalation

  • Act as an escalation point for complex or edge-case filing scenarios.

  • Diagnose issues raised by Operating Teams, Product, or Sales and determine resolution paths.

  • Coordinate with internal teams and external advisors when clarification is required.

Product & Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to design and improve filing workflows and automation.

  • Translate tax requirements into clear inputs for system logic, data models, and product features.

  • Review and test new filing capabilities from a tax-requirements perspective.

Scaling & Process Improvement

  • Identify gaps, risks, and inefficiencies in current filing coverage and workflows.

  • Propose scalable, system-driven solutions that reduce manual intervention.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in indirect tax compliance, tax operations, or tax advisory with U.S. and international exposure.

  • Strong understanding of tax filing requirements across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate tax rules into operational or technical requirements.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, or operations teams.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure from incomplete information.

  • Startup mindset: Not scared of ambiguity and hungry for rapid growth

  • Intensity & Ownership: This is not a 9-5 — we’re scaling rapidly and have a massive opportunity ahead of us.

  • Customer Obsession: You deeply care about the user experience and solving their problems

Even better:

  • Experience in SaaS, fintech, or other technology-driven environments.

  • Background in tax automation, systems design, or workflow tooling.

  • Familiarity working with external tax advisors or local country specialists.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity - you’ll share directly in the company’s success

  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Wellness perks like Headspace and the Peloton One App

  • 401(k) to help you build long-term financial security

  • Lunch and snacks when you’re in the office

  • Regular team offsites and company events as we grow

  • A culture built on ownership - your work matters and people will see it!

This role sits at the intersection of project management, technical troubleshooting, and high-touch customer advocacy.

You’ll be joining at a hyper-growth stage where "standard operating procedure" is still being written. You won't just follow a playbook; you’ll help us rewrite it to be faster, leaner, and more automated. If you love the puzzle of complex data and the "win" of a successful launch, this is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Own the Launch: Lead the end-to-end onboarding journey for a high-volume book of business, ensuring every merchant hits their "Go-Live" date with 100% accuracy.

  • Be the Expert: Act as a trusted advisor for clients, guiding them through tax registrations, data transfers, and platform configuration.

  • Drive Velocity: Obsess over "Time-to-Value." Identify bottlenecks in our process and work cross-functionally to remove them.

  • Bridge the Gap: Translate complex customer needs into actionable feedback for our Product and Engineering teams.

  • Build the Engine: Create the documentation, help center articles, and internal playbooks that allow us to scale without losing our "white-glove" touch.

  • Technical Troubleshooting: Dig into data imports and integration settings to ensure our customers' financial data is flowing perfectly.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in Implementation, Onboarding, Customer Success, or Operations. Startup experience is a massive plus.

  • High Operational Rigor: You are a project management pro. You don't let balls drop, and you thrive when juggling 20+ active implementations.

  • Technical Empathy: You can explain complex logic (like tax nexus or API integrations) to a non-technical founder with ease.

  • Bias for Action: When you see a broken process, you fix it. You don't wait for permission to make things better.

  • The "Craft" Mindset: You care about the details. In tax compliance, "almost right" is wrong.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with SQL, advanced Excel/Sheets, or data migration workflows.

  • Experience in Fintech, SaaS, or E-commerce ecosystems.

  • Experience using AI tools (LLMs/Prompts) to automate manual parts of your workflow.

  • You’ve been an early employee at a fast-growing company and know how to thrive in "organized chaos."

Why Join Us?

  • Career Trajectory: Join a Benchmark-backed team where your work directly impacts the company's valuation and growth.

  • High-Caliber Peers: Work with alumni from Stripe, Airbnb, and Notion who value high-craft execution.

  • Ownership: We don't micromanage. We give you a goal and the autonomy to figure out the best way to get there.

  • Remote-First Culture: We value output over "hours in a seat," with strong mentorship and growth opportunities.

Numeral is building the automation backbone for internet commerce — starting with the painful world of sales tax compliance. Our mission is to eliminate the administrative and accounting burdens that distract businesses from doing what they love. We’ve already helped hundreds of merchants avoid the headache of building giant finance teams just to manage tax compliance. Tomorrow, we’re building the automation layer that lets internet businesses stay nimble, compliant, and future-proof.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Registrations Specialist based in El Salvador to join our global operations team. While our Sales team identifies the need and our Implementation Managers (IMs) design the strategy, you are the one who makes it a reality. You are the "execution engine" of Numeral, responsible for fulfilling the compliance promises we make to our customers.

This is a high-stakes, detail-oriented role. You will navigate the labyrinth of US state and international tax portals, ensuring that the "white-glove service" promised during the sales process is delivered with 100% surgical precision. You don't just follow a list; you build the systems that make our promises scalable.

Responsibilities

  • Promise Fulfillment: Take ownership of the "sold" compliance package and ensure every promised registration and nexus setup is executed accurately and on time.

  • The Hand-off: Receive "ready-to-file" packets from Implementation Managers and drive them through to completion across 50+ US states and international jurisdictions.

  • Portal Architecture: Own the setup and maintenance of government tax portals, managing credentials and documentation with extreme organization.

  • Jurisdictional Liaison: Proactively track registration statuses and follow up with government agencies to resolve blockers—you are the persistent voice ensuring our customers don't get stuck in "government limbo."

  • Notice Management: Review and route incoming jurisdictional mail and notices, ensuring urgent tax matters are escalated and resolved immediately.

  • Data Integrity: Maintain a "source of truth" for all client registrations and logins—ensuring our internal systems perfectly mirror the promises made to the customer.

  • Process Evolution: Identify patterns where "Sales promises" meet "Jurisdictional reality" and help refine our internal playbooks to close that gap.

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in Operations, Compliance, or Administrative roles. (Experience in a US-facing startup or BPO environment is a major plus).

  • Advanced English Proficiency: You must be comfortable reading complex legal/tax forms and communicating clearly with US-based team members.

  • Obsessive Attention to Detail: You catch the typos that others miss. In tax compliance, a single wrong digit can cause months of delays.

  • Tech-Savvy: You can quickly learn to navigate 50+ different (and often outdated) government websites and portals.

  • High Ownership: You don't wait for a status update; you go find it. You take personal pride in "closing the loop" on every task.

Bonus Points

  • Prior experience with US Sales Tax or regulatory compliance.

  • Experience using modern ops tools (Slack, Notion, Ashby, or Airtable).

  • You have built or improved a "back-office" process from scratch.

  • Experience in Fintech, SaaS, or E-commerce operations.

Why Join Us?

  • Global Exposure: Work directly with a Silicon Valley team and learn the inner workings of the US e-commerce ecosystem.

  • Build, Don't Just Execute: We value your ideas on how to make our registration engine better, faster, and more automated.

  • Immediate Impact: You are the final link in the chain that ensures our customers stay compliant and happy.

  • Hybrid Culture: Enjoy a flexible, hybrid work environment that balances remote work with meaningful in-person collaboration at our local office.
